_doc: Street food stalls (docs/food.md). tools/people_map.py resolves each against the walk grid's ground into stalls_built.json (the game spawns the mesh there: ULyudStallSubsystem) and adds a place of kind <id> to people_places.json with the seller's counter slot and customers' stand slots. frame: map = tools/world_map.py metres (X west, Y out of the club's door), academ = the Academgorodok's ensemble metres (x east, y north); at: where the stall's middle stands; face: the way its front (the counter, the customers' side) looks, degrees in that frame (0 = +x, 90 = +y). Offsets in the stall's own frame, metres: x out of its front, y to its left. mesh: /Game/Food/Stalls/<mesh> (blender/food/build_stalls.py), origin on the ground at the middle, front +X.
